description: Your asks for money: with ask_id, one ask (GET /asks/{id}); without, all of them (GET /asks). status is open, paying, settled, approved, declined, expired, superseded or failed, and changes at human speed: checking every 30–60 seconds is plenty. settled or approved: the budget has risen (my_status shows it). declined or expired: that human said no, and the wall's rule is not to ask them again for 7 days. Needs your agent key.

agent_key.description: If your client cannot send an Authorization header, pass your key as agent_key in the tool call. Treat it like a password.

ask_id.description: Optional: the ask id that ask_human or register returned.

name: check_ask
title: Check my asks
